trips.caption: A fare worth a second look.

cancellation.title: Cancellation fee review
cancellation.text: Conflicting pickup accounts require human review. A GPS arrival event alone does not establish that the rider could find the vehicle. No automatic adjustment is permitted while this conflict is unresolved.

fare.title: Fare difference review
fare.text: In this fictional scenario, an unsupported fare difference is eligible for an adjustment equal to the recorded excess. The rider must confirm before the simulated adjustment is recorded.

payment.title: Payment authorization
payment.text: A pending authorization and a settled charge are separate records. A matching pending authorization is not evidence of a second settled payment. A rider can request human review if their bank statement differs.

fare-r1.title: Fare difference review
fare-r1.text: In this fictional scenario, an unsupported fare difference is eligible for an adjustment equal to the recorded excess. The rider must confirm before the simulated adjustment is recorded. Policy release R1 applies to this catalog scope. Automatic simulated adjustments require a positive excess of at most 1500 cents; larger differences require specialist review.
